mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with an elevated air quality index of 51.

The City of Verona has announced that September is Hunger Action Month, with Mayor Diaz encouraging residents to donate and volunteer to address food insecurity. Additionally, construction flagging is scheduled on Highway M for utility work on August 31 and September 1, so please plan for extra travel time.
There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Area Kids Triathlon or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
Looking at the weekly police report, on August 21, an officer conducted a traffic stop for expired registration and subsequently cited the driver for possession of marijuana.
The flavor of the day at Culver's today is the delicious Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
